problem_type: Catalog selection based on textual proximity instead of object ownership
symptom: Executable audit manifest excerpts falsely report existing Agent tools as missing MCP tools.
direct_cause: isHostFixture checks only 240 preceding characters and requires type before name.
class_root: Tool reference catalog identity is not bound to the owning object structure.
internal_only_reason: Internal lint classification of existing repository tool shapes; no external API contract or runtime behavior changes.
invariants: Host name properties use Agent catalog only when their own object has the host discriminator or complete manifest field signature.
All positional MCP calls and other name properties use MCP catalog; unknown names remain invalid.
generality_proof: Shared object-boundary classification ignores field order, distance, comments and nested values, and never inherits sibling or parent discriminators.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind each name property to the catalog selected by its own object.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Restored ts fence scanned by scanFile -> scanSource; complete manifest signature selects Agent.
Repository scan finds reply.type tool and nomi_canvas_plan; scanSource owns all fixture classification.
Same type tool discriminator; covered by object-local long/reordered/nested-field regression tests.

recurrence.reason: Any new fixture or documentation excerpt can reorder fields or exceed the window.
same_class_scan: rg isHostFixture|scanSource scripts/check-mcp* identifies one shared boundary.
rg type: .tool. tests/ux finds production, editing, golden-path and artifact fixtures.
rg modelToolSurfaceManifest|agentToolCatalog docs/audit finds audit and architecture-review references.

prevention.invariant: Catalog comes from direct properties of the owning object, never a context window.
prevention.failure_mode: Names absent from the selected real catalog fail the existing gate.
prevention.strategy: Replace proximity regex with TypeScript-token object grouping and direct-field shape recognition.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove isHostFixture bounded lookbehind and revert the text-fence workaround.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency defect or new package; reuse installed TypeScript scanner for token boundaries.

migration: No stored data or runtime changes; existing fixtures retain their source format.
residual_risks: Computed/dynamic names remain outside the existing literal-reference gate scope.
